set.approach: From the meadow camp, climb to the col between the Deacon and the Matriarch, then follow the ridgeline toward the Deacon and drop onto snow and talus to the foot of the north-east wall. Sentinel Direct starts at the V-shaped feature on the left side of the wall.

review.notes: Approach from area page; start at shared V from Heretic page. No descent source for this route.

set.approach: From the meadow camp, climb to the col between the Deacon and the Matriarch, then follow the ridgeline toward the Deacon and drop onto snow and talus to the foot of the north-east wall. The Heretic starts at the V-shaped feature on the left side of the wall, shared with Sentinel Direct.
set.descent_text: The route finishes on easy ground, then scrambles to the summit. Scramble along the ridge, then step off it ahead of the loose, blocky towers; one short rappel leads to a traverse across and up through chossy rock that is gentler and less exposed than the towers. From the summit, follow the ridgeline down. Cornices build over the gullies, so do not shortcut across early-season snow.

review.notes: Approach: area page, route page, club trip report agree on start at V. Descent from route page only.

set.approach: Approach up the lower Vowell Glacier into the cirque, then angle right to the start on the east side of the ridge. Easy scrambling leads to where the technical climbing begins.
set.descent_text: The route tops out on the third summit of the ridge. Rappel down the ridgeline to the glacier; do not count on fixed anchors, so carry gear to build your own. Retreat off either face is difficult, so avoid the route if storms are likely.

review.notes: Route page only; rappel count omitted (single source).
